title: feat: add ElevenLabs text to dialogue
author: ElliotEtag
pr_body_excerpt:
- Adds `eleven-dialogue` with `dialogue` and `text-to-dialogue` aliases.
- Adds `POST /v1/audio/dialogue` for up to 10 voices, 25 turns, and 2,000 total characters.
- Bills the direct ElevenLabs v3 route at $0.10/1K characters, paid-only, multiplier 1, with no fallback or Pollinations GPU.
- Batches all dialogue safety checks into one guardrail request and rejects oversized input before safety/provider calls.
- Encodes custom voice IDs at the provider URL boundary and exposes accurate supported endpoints.

Validation:
- Live full-route MP3 and WAV generations with two voice pairs and alias routing.
- Exact deductions verified: 9 chars = 0.0009 Pollen; 29 chars = 0.0029 Pollen.
- 11 focused tests and Gen typecheck pass; oversized, unique-voice, invalid-voice, and URL-injection cases covered.
- Existing ElevenLabs brand logo resolves in the catalog.

### Endpoint-gating follow-up (2026-07-26)

- Fixed the standard TTS routing regression introduced by endpoint metadata: generic audio defaults now include both /audio/{text} and /v1/audio/speech, and both routes pass their exact endpoint identity.
- Added route-level coverage for explicit elevenlabs, omitted/default model, and the simple GET route; all return 200.
- Latest stacked Gen verification: typecheck clean, paid modality E2E clean, and 694/694 tests across 74 files pass.
- Documented the measured 12 credits/second audio-input metering and its Scale-plan reconciliation in code.
- CI follow-up: the deterministic route test now injects a test-only provider key through the Worker environment; the secretless GitHub suite passes.

gist.headline: The hive learned dialogue
gist.blurb: ElevenLabs v3 can now handle a whole tiny radio play, not just one bee at a time. Send the cast, get the scene back as MP3 or WAV.
gist.summary: Added the paid ElevenLabs `eleven-dialogue` model (also available as `dialogue` and `text-to-dialogue`) and `POST /v1/audio/dialogue`, supporting up to 10 voices, 25 turns, and 2,000 total characters at $0.10 per 1K characters.
gist.impact: Developers can generate multi-speaker ElevenLabs dialogue through one Pollinations endpoint, while standard TTS continues to work on both `/audio/{text}` and `/v1/audio/speech` routes.
gist.visual_concept: Depict a cozy recording garden where Polli directs a small multi-voice radio drama: several friendly retro microphones or speaker flowers represent the supported voices, while a CRT terminal displays a dialogue script and emits gentle audio waveforms. Polli should wear tiny director headphones and hold a clipboard, with code-plants and an ElevenLabs-style sound studio atmosphere making the new multi-speaker endpoint legible.
